title: Polar motion transfer function

source.citation: Spada, G. et al. (2011). Geophysical Journal International 185(1), 106-132.

what_to_compute: Compute the coefficients of the polar motion transfer function M(s) in the Laplace domain: the secular and elastic rotational residues and the rotational characteristic frequencies.

reference_data.$comment: Contributor abbreviations are those of the paper's table 1. For a converted test, the files read and what each column holds are in the `files` table of gia_mip/resources/spada_column_layouts.json. `not_converted` gives, per contributor, the reason its data is not in the converted file.

not_converted.GS: T01-04/ holds GS-ncw.dat, GS-ycw.dat and related files. No GMT script in the archive draws them, and nothing documents their columns, so they are not decoded. SpadaResult holds Love numbers with residues, relaxation spectra and surface profiles, and not the polar motion transfer function, so this test has no reader yet.
not_converted.VB: T01-04/ holds VB-ncw.txt, VB-ycw.txt and related files. No GMT script in the archive draws them, and nothing documents their columns, so they are not decoded. SpadaResult holds Love numbers with residues, relaxation spectra and surface profiles, and not the polar motion transfer function, so this test has no reader yet.

status: not converted: the files of T01-04/ are not decoded, and no result class holds a polar motion transfer function.
